title: Periodic Steady-State Control of a Handkerchief-Spinning Task Using a Parallel Anti-Parallelogram Tendon-driven Wrist
summary: Spinning flexible objects, exemplified by traditional Chinese handkerchief performances, demands periodic steady-state motions under nonlinear dynamics with frictional contacts and boundary constraints. To address these challenges, we first design an intuitive dexterous wrist based on a parallel anti-parallelogram tendon-driven structure, which achieves 90 degrees omnidirectional rotation with low inertia and decoupled roll-pitch sensing, and implement a high-low level hierarchical control scheme. We then develop a particle-spring model of the handkerchief for control-oriented abstraction and strategy evaluation. Hardware experiments validate this framework, achieving an unfolding ratio of approximately 99% and fingertip tracking error of RMSE = 2.88 mm in high-dynamic spinning. These results demonstrate that integrating control-oriented modeling with a task-tailored dexterous wrist enables robust rest-to-steady-state transitions and precise periodic manipulation of highly flexible objects. More visualizations: https://slowly1113.github.io/icra2026-handkerchief/

title: The dimensions of Schur squares of HRS codes
summary: The Schur square of linear codes over a finite field has emerged as a fundamental operation in both classical and quantum coding theory. In this paper, we investigate the Schur square problem of Hyperderivative Reed-Solomon (HRS) codes. By solving certain special determinants, we first give a lower bound and an upper bound for the dimensions of Schur squares of HRS codes, and then prove that when $p\geq t\geq 2s$ and $t\leq \frac{r+2s-1}{2}$, the dimension of the Schur square of the HRS code $HRS_{t}(\{α_{1},\dots,α_{r}\},s)$ (with length $rs$ and dimension $t$) reaches the upper bound $(2t-2s+1)s$. In particular, when $p \ge t=2s$ and $r\geq t+1$, the dimension of the Schur square equals $\frac{t(t+1)}{2}$ which is the dimension of the Schur squares of random codes with high probability. As an application in code-based cryptography, HRS codes with specific parameter settings might resist the attack of Schur square distinguisher.

title: Sharpening Lightweight Models for Generalized Polyp Segmentation: A Boundary Guided Distillation from Foundation Models
summary: Automated polyp segmentation is critical for early colorectal cancer detection and its prevention, yet remains challenging due to weak boundaries, large appearance variations, and limited annotated data. Lightweight segmentation models such as U-Net, U-Net++, and PraNet offer practical efficiency for clinical deployment but struggle to capture the rich semantic and structural cues required for accurate delineation of complex polyp regions. In contrast, large Vision Foundation Models (VFMs), including SAM, OneFormer, Mask2Former, and DINOv2, exhibit strong generalization but transfer poorly to polyp segmentation due to domain mismatch, insufficient boundary sensitivity, and high computational cost. To bridge this gap, we propose \textit{\textbf{LiteBounD}, a \underline{Li}gh\underline{t}w\underline{e}ight \underline{Boun}dary-guided \underline{D}istillation} framework that transfers complementary semantic and structural priors from multiple VFMs into compact segmentation backbones. LiteBounD introduces (i) a dual-path distillation mechanism that disentangles semantic and boundary-aware representations, (ii) a frequency-aware alignment strategy that supervises low-frequency global semantics and high-frequency boundary details separately, and (iii) a boundary-aware decoder that fuses multi-scale encoder features with distilled semantically rich boundary information for precise segmentation. Extensive experiments on both seen (Kvasir-SEG, CVC-ClinicDB) and unseen (ColonDB, CVC-300, ETIS) datasets demonstrate that LiteBounD consistently outperforms its lightweight baselines by a significant margin and achieves performance competitive with state-of-the-art methods, while maintaining the efficiency required for real-time clinical use. Our code is available at https://github.com/lostinrepo/LiteBounD.

title: Latent Abstraction for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become a standard approach for enhancing large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge, mitigating hallucinations, and improving factuality. However, existing systems rely on generating natural language queries at each hop and maintaining a strict architectural separation between retriever and generator, preventing them from leveraging the full representational capacity of the LLM. We propose \textbf{LAnR} (Latent Abstraction for RAG), a unified framework in which a single LLM jointly performs encoding, retrieval, and generation entirely within its own latent space. Rather than generating textual queries, LAnR produces dense retrieval vectors from the hidden states of a designated \texttt{[PRED]} token and uses them to match against encoded document representations from the same model. Furthermore, LAnR adaptively decides when sufficient evidence has been retrieved using a lightweight MLP control head over those same hidden states, eliminating both the separate retriever and explicit token-level stopping reasoning. This design is motivated by our empirical observation that answer token entropy reliably signals retrieval sufficiency. Extensive experiments on six QA benchmarks spanning single-hop and multi-hop settings demonstrate that LAnR outperforms existing RAG methods, while achieving improved inference efficiency through reduced number of retrieval calls and tighter model integration.

title: GraSP: Graph-Structured Skill Compositions for LLM Agents
summary: Skill ecosystems for LLM agents have matured rapidly, yet recent benchmarks show that providing agents with more skills does not monotonically improve performance -- focused sets of 2-3 skills outperform comprehensive documentation, and excessive skills actually hurt. The bottleneck has shifted from skill availability to skill orchestration: agents need not more skills, but a structural mechanism to select, compose, and execute them with explicit causal dependencies. We propose GraSP, the first executable skill graph architecture that introduces a compilation layer between skill retrieval and execution. GraSP transforms flat skill sets into typed directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) with precondition-effect edges, executes them with node-level verification, and performs locality-bounded repair through five typed operators -- reducing replanning from O(N) to O(d^h). Across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, WebShop, and InterCode with eight LLM backbones, GraSP outperforms ReAct, Reflexion, ExpeL, and flat skill baselines in every configuration, improving reward by up to +19 points over the strongest baseline while cutting environment steps by up to 41%. GraSP's advantage grows with task complexity and is robust to both skill over-retrieval and quality degradation, confirming that structured orchestration -- not larger skill libraries -- is the key to reliable agent execution.

title: Design and Evaluation of a Culturally Adapted Multimodal Virtual Agent for PTSD Screening
summary: Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) is highly prevalent yet chronically underreported among combat-exposed military personnel. This paper presents Molhim, a culturally adapted multimodal conversational AI platform that supports purpose-specific interactions through a configurable conversational pipeline consisting of session setup, real-time dialogue with a high-fidelity virtual avatar, and post-session analysis and feedback. In this work, we examine the PTSD screening configuration of the Molhim platform in a military healthcare context. The system employs a conversational avatar driven by a large language model, integrating real-time speech recognition, visual understanding of user input, text-to-speech synthesis, and a high-fidelity human avatar to support structured multi-turn dialogue and automated post-session analysis, including administration of the PTSD Checklist for DSM-5 (PCL-5). These findings suggest the feasibility of Molhim as a conversational platform for PTSD screening and highlight design considerations for socially cooperative human-AI systems in clinical environments.

title: On Scalability of Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithms on Combinatorial Optimisation Problems
summary: Scalability of evolutionary algorithms refers to assessing how their performance changes as problem size increases. In the area of multi-objective optimisation, research on the scalability of multi-objective evolutionary algorithms (MOEAs) has predominantly focussed on continuous problems. However, multi-objective combinatorial optimisation problems (MOCOPs) differ from continuous ones. Their discrete and rigid structure often brings rugged landscape, numerous local optimal solutions and disjoint global optimal regions. This leads to different behaviour of MOEAs. For example, SEMO, a simple MOEA without mating selection and diversity maintenance mechanisms, has been shown to be highly competitive, and in many cases to outperform more sophisticated MOEAs on MOCOPs. Yet, it remains unclear whether such findings hold for large-scale cases. In this paper, we conduct an empirical investigation into the scalability of MOEAs on combinatorial problems, with problem size from 50 to 5,000. Our results show that SEMO experiences a decline in convergence speed as dimensionality increases, compared to other MOEAs such as NSGA-II, SMS-EMOA and MOEA/D. We further demonstrate that the absence of crossover is a major contributor to SEMO's underperformance in large-scale problems, and that incorporating crossover into SEMO can substantially accelerate convergence in general, despite being detrimental in spreading solutions over the Pareto front.

title: Spatiotemporal Sycophancy: Negation-Based Gaslighting in Video Large Language Models
summary: Video Large Language Models (Vid-LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance in video understanding tasks, yet their robustness under conversational interaction remains largely underexplored. In this paper, we identify spatiotemporal sycophancy, a failure mode in which Vid-LLMs retract initially correct, visually grounded judgments and conform to misleading user feedback under negation-based gaslighting. Rather than merely changing their answers, the models often fabricate unsupported temporal or spatial explanations to justify incorrect revisions. To systematically investigate this phenomenon, we propose a negation-based gaslighting evaluation framework and introduce GasVideo-1000, a curated benchmark designed to probe spatiotemporal sycophancy with clear visual grounding and temporal reasoning requirements. We evaluate a broad range of state-of-the-art open-source and proprietary Vid-LLMs across diverse video understanding tasks. Extensive experiments reveal that vulnerability to negation-based gaslighting is pervasive and severe, even among models with strong baseline performance. While prompt-level grounding constraints can partially mitigate this behavior, they do not reliably prevent hallucinated justifications or belief reversal. Our results indicate that current Vid-LLMs lack robust mechanisms for maintaining grounded spatiotemporal beliefs under adversarial conversational feedback.

title: OFlow: Injecting Object-Aware Temporal Flow Matching for Robust Robotic Manipulation
summary: Robust robotic manipulation requires not only predicting how the scene evolves over time, but also recognizing task-relevant objects in complex scenes. However, existing VLA models face two limitations. They typically act only on the current frame, while future prediction and object-aware reasoning are often learned in separate latent spaces. We propose OFlow (injecting Object-Aware Temporal Flow Matching into VLAs), a framework that addresses both limitations by unifying temporal foresight and object-aware reasoning in a shared semantic latent space. Our method forecasts future latents with temporal flow matching, factorizes them into object-aware representations that emphasize physically relevant cues while filtering task-irrelevant variation, and conditions continuous action generation on these predictions. By integrating OFlow into VLA pipelines, our method enables more reliable control under distribution shifts. Extensive experiments across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, MetaWorld, and SimplerEnv benchmarks and real-world tasks demonstrate that object-aware foresight consistently enhances robustness and success.

title: RankUp: Towards High-rank Representations for Large Scale Advertising Recommender Systems
summary: The scaling laws for recommender systems have been increasingly validated, where MetaFormer-based architectures consistently benefit from increased model depth, hidden dimensionality, and user behavior sequence length. However, whether representation capacity scales proportionally with parameter growth remains largely unexplored. Prior studies on RankMixer reveal that the effective rank of token representations exhibits a damped oscillatory trajectory across layers, failing to increase consistently with depth and even degrading in deeper layers. Motivated by this observation, we propose \textbf{RankUp}, an architecture designed to mitigate representation collapse and enhance expressive capacity through randomized permutation splitting over sparse features, a multi-embedding paradigm, global token integration, crossed pretrained embedding tokens and task-specific token decoupling. RankUp has been fully deployed in large-scale production across Weixin Video Accounts, Official Accounts and Moments, yielding GMV improvements of 3.41\%, 4.81\% and 2.21\%, respectively.

title: Exploring Boundary-Aware Spatial-Frequency Fusion for Camouflaged Object Detection
summary: Camouflaged Object Detection is challenging due to the high degree of similarity between camouflaged objects and their surrounding backgrounds. Current COD methods mainly rely on edge extraction in the spatial domain and local pixel-level information, neglecting the importance of global structural features. Additionally, they fail to effectively leverage the importance of phase spectrum information within frequency domain features. To this end, we propose a COD framework BASFNet based on boundary-aware frequency domain and spatial domain fusion.This method uses dual guided integration of frequency domain and spatial domain features. A phase-spectrum-based frequency-enhanced edge exploration module (FEEM) and a spatial core segmentation module (SCSM) are introduced to jointly capture the boundary and object features of camouflaged objects. These features are then effectively integrated through a spatial-frequency fusion interaction module (SFFIM). Furthermore, the boundary detection is further optimized through an boundary-aware training strategy. BASFNet outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods on three benchmark datasets, validating the effectiveness of the fusion of frequency and spatial domain information in COD tasks.

title: ST-$π$: Structured SpatioTemporal VLA for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved great success on general robotic tasks, but still face challenges in fine-grained spatiotemporal manipulation. Typically, existing methods mainly embed spatiotemporal knowledge into visual and action representations, and directly perform a cross-modal mapping for step-level action prediction. However, such spatiotemporal reasoning remains largely implicit, making it difficult to handle multiple sequential behaviors with explicit spatiotemporal boundaries. In this work, we propose ST-$π$, a structured spatiotemporal VLA model for robotic manipulation. Our model is guided by two key designs: 1) Spatiotemporal VLM. We encode 4D observations and task instructions into latent spaces, and feed them into the LLM to generate a sequence of causally ordered chunk-level action prompts consisting of sub-tasks, spatial grounding and temporal grounding. 2) Spatiotemporal action expert. Conditioned on chunk-level action prompts, we design a structured dual-generator guidance to jointly model spatial dependencies and temporal causality, thus predicting step-level action parameters. Within this structured framework, the VLM explicitly plans global spatiotemporal behavior, and the action expert further refines local spatiotemporal control. In addition, we propose a real-world robotic dataset with structured spatiotemporal annotations for fine-tuning. Extensive experiments have been conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness of our model. Our code link: https://github.com/chuanhaoma/ST-pi.

title: Scaling Human-AI Coding Collaboration Requires a Governable Consensus Layer
summary: Vibe coding produces correct, executable code at speed, but leaves no record of the structural commitments, dependencies, or evidence behind it. Reviewers cannot determine what invariants were assumed, what changed, or why a regression occurred. This is not a generation failure but a control failure: the dominant artifact of AI-assisted development (code plus chat history) performs dimension collapse, flattening complex system topology into low-dimensional text and making systems opaque and fragile under change. We propose Agentic Consensus: a paradigm in which the consensus layer C, an operable world model represented as a typed property graph, replaces code as the primary artifact of engineering. Executable artifacts are derived from C and kept in correspondence via synchronization operators Phi (realize) and Psi (rehydrate). Evidence links directly to structural claims in C, making every commitment auditable and under-specification explicit as measurable consensus entropy rather than a silent guess. Evaluation must move beyond code correctness toward alignment fidelity, consensus entropy, and intervention distance. We propose benchmark task families designed to measure whether consensus-based workflows reduce human intervention compared to chat-driven baselines.

AI.title_translation: 扩展人机协作编程需要一个可治理的共识层
AI.tldr: 现有AI编程缺乏结构记录和可审计性，导致系统脆弱。本文提出“代理共识”范式，用可操作的共识层（类型化属性图）替代代码作为主要工程产物，以提高可审计性、减少人为干预。
AI.motivation: 现有的AI辅助编程（vibe coding）能快速生成代码，但缺乏对结构承诺、依赖和证据的记录，导致评审者难以理解假设、变更和回归原因。AI辅助开发的主要产物（代码加聊天记录）将复杂的系统拓扑扁平化为低维文本，使得系统不透明且在变更下脆弱。
AI.method: 提出“代理共识”（Agentic Consensus）范式，其中一个可操作的世界模型（表示为类型化属性图）作为共识层C，取代代码成为主要的工程产物。可执行产物从C派生，并通过同步操作符Phi（实现）和Psi（再水化）保持一致。证据直接链接到C中的结构声明，使每个承诺都可审计，并将规范不足明确为可测量的共识熵，而非无声的猜测。
AI.result: 使得每个承诺都可审计，并将规范不足明确为可测量的共识熵。预期能减少人类干预，提高系统透明度和稳定性。
AI.conclusion: AI辅助编程的评估应超越代码正确性，转向对齐保真度、共识熵和干预距离。本文提出了基准任务家族，旨在衡量基于共识的工作流程是否能比基于聊天的基线减少人类干预。
AI.translation: 氛围编程（Vibe coding）能够快速生成正确、可执行的代码，但没有留下结构承诺、依赖关系或其背后证据的记录。评审人员无法确定假设了哪些不变性、哪些发生了变化，或者为什么会发生回归。这并非生成失败，而是控制失败：AI辅助开发的主要产物（代码加聊天历史）执行了维度坍塌，将复杂的系统拓扑扁平化为低维文本，使得系统在变化下变得不透明且脆弱。我们提出代理共识（Agentic Consensus）：一种范式，其中共识层C，一个表示为类型化属性图的可操作世界模型，取代代码成为主要的工程产物。可执行产物从C派生，并通过同步操作符Phi（实现）和Psi（再水化）保持一致。证据直接链接到C中的结构声明，使得每个承诺都可审计，并将规范不足明确为可测量的共识熵，而非无声的猜测。评估必须超越代码正确性，转向对齐保真度、共识熵和干预距离。我们提出了基准任务家族，旨在衡量基于共识的工作流程是否能比基于聊天的基线减少人类干预。
AI.summary: 本文指出当前AI辅助编程（vibe coding）在快速生成代码的同时，缺乏对结构承诺和依赖的记录，导致系统不透明且脆弱。为解决此“控制失败”，作者提出了“代理共识”范式，将一个表示为类型化属性图的可操作共识层C作为主要工程产物，取代代码。通过同步操作符，可执行产物从C派生并保持一致，同时证据直接链接到C，使所有承诺可审计，并将规范不足量化为共识熵。文章强调评估应转向对齐保真度、共识熵和干预距离，并提出了相应的基准任务来衡量基于共识的工作流程能否减少人为干预。
AI.keywords: 人机协作编程, 代理共识, 共识层, 类型化属性图, AI辅助开发
AI.comments: 这篇论文提出了一个重要的视角，将当前AI辅助编程的问题归结为“控制失败”而非“生成失败”，并提出了一个创新的解决方案——“代理共识”。其核心思想是用一个可治理的、结构化的共识层（类型化属性图）来取代代码作为主要工程产物，这有望从根本上解决现有AI生成代码的可审计性、可维护性和透明度问题。通过量化“共识熵”来识别规范不足，也提供了一个新的衡量指标。该方法对于提升大型复杂系统在AI辅助下的开发质量和可信度具有重要意义。

title: SPREG: Structured Plan Repair with Entropy-Guided Test-Time Intervention for Large Language Model Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are prone to logical hallucinations and stochastic drifts during long-chain reasoning. While Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) can improve instruction adherence, standard static implementations often cause semantic dilution and linguistic degradation. We propose SPREG (Structured Plan-guided Real-time Entropy Gating), a lightweight inference-time framework for surgical error rectification. SPREG employs an adaptive dual-threshold mechanism to monitor real-time entropy, identifying sudden ``entropy spikes'' as reliable indicators of logical failure. Upon detection, it triggers a dynamic repair by replacing uninformative null-priors with reference distributions synthesized from historical high-confidence states. By modulating guidance intensity according to structured reasoning stages (e.g., Action, Observation), SPREG steers the model back to a stable manifold without compromising fluency. Our experiments demonstrate significant gains, notably a 20.0% absolute accuracy improvement on AIME25, while effectively suppressing uncontrolled entropy drift in complex tasks.

AI.title_translation: SPREG：基于熵引导测试时干预的结构化计划修复，用于大型语言模型推理
AI.tldr: SPREG通过实时熵监控和动态修复，纠正LLM在长链推理中的逻辑错误，显著提升准确性并抑制熵漂移。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在长链推理中容易出现逻辑幻觉和随机漂移。标准的静态无分类器引导（CFG）实现常导致语义稀释和语言质量下降。
AI.method: SPREG（Structured Plan-guided Real-time Entropy Gating）是一个轻量级的推理时框架。它采用自适应双阈值机制监控实时熵，将突然的“熵峰值”识别为逻辑失败的可靠指标。检测到错误后，通过用历史高置信度状态合成的参考分布替换无信息的空先验来触发动态修复。通过根据结构化推理阶段（如Action, Observation）调节引导强度，将模型引导回稳定流形。
AI.result: 在AIME25上实现了20.0%的绝对准确率提升，并有效抑制了复杂任务中不受控制的熵漂移。
AI.conclusion: SPREG能够有效纠正大型语言模型在长链推理中的逻辑错误和随机漂移，显著提升其性能和稳定性，且不损害流畅性。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在长链推理中容易出现逻辑幻觉和随机漂移。虽然无分类器引导（CFG）可以提高指令依从性，但标准的静态实现通常会导致语义稀释和语言质量下降。我们提出了SPREG（Structured Plan-guided Real-time Entropy Gating），一个轻量级的推理时框架，用于精准的错误纠正。SPREG采用自适应双阈值机制监控实时熵，将突然的“熵峰值”识别为逻辑失败的可靠指标。一旦检测到，它会通过用历史高置信度状态合成的参考分布替换无信息的空先验来触发动态修复。通过根据结构化推理阶段（例如，Action，Observation）调节引导强度，SPREG在不损害流畅性的情况下将模型引导回稳定流形。我们的实验证明了显著的增益，尤其是在AIME25上实现了20.0%的绝对准确率提升，同时有效抑制了复杂任务中不受控制的熵漂移。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SPREG框架，旨在解决大型语言模型在长链推理中常见的逻辑错误和随机漂移问题。SPREG通过实时监控熵值来检测潜在的逻辑失败，并动态地进行修复，利用历史高置信度状态的参考分布来引导模型。该方法在不影响语言流畅性的前提下，显著提升了模型在复杂推理任务中的准确性，并有效抑制了熵漂移。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 推理, 熵引导, 错误修复, CFG
AI.comments: SPREG的创新点在于其轻量级的推理时框架，结合实时熵监控和动态修复机制，能够“手术式”地纠正LLM推理错误，避免了传统CFG方法的缺点。其结合结构化推理阶段进行引导，提升了修复的精准性。

title: Surreal Arithmetic, Lazily
summary: Conway's surreal numbers were aptly named by Knuth. This note examines how far one can get towards implementing surreals and the arithmetic operations on them so that they execute efficiently. Lazy evaluation and recursive data structures yield a considerable speed up.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了如何利用惰性求值和递归数据结构高效地实现超现实数及其算术运算，并取得了显著的加速效果。
AI.motivation: 研究如何高效地实现康威的超现实数及其算术运算。
AI.method: 采用惰性求值和递归数据结构。
AI.conclusion: 惰性求值和递归数据结构可以显著提高超现实数及其算术运算的实现效率。
AI.translation: 康威的超现实数被高明地命名为“Knuth”。本文探讨了在实现超现实数及其算术运算方面能走多远，以使其高效执行。惰性求值和递归数据结构带来了相当大的加速。
AI.summary: 本文研究了如何高效实现康威的超现实数及其算术运算。通过应用惰性求值和递归数据结构，作者成功地显著提高了这些运算的执行速度。
AI.keywords: 超现实数, 惰性求值, 递归数据结构, 算术运算, 效率
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将惰性求值和递归数据结构应用于超现实数的实现，解决了传统方法可能面临的效率问题。这对于需要处理复杂数学结构计算的领域具有潜在的重要性。

title: Latent Preference Modeling for Cross-Session Personalized Tool Calling
summary: Users often omit essential details in their requests to LLM-based agents, resulting in under-specified inputs for tool use. This poses a fundamental challenge for tool-augmented agents, as API execution typically requires complete arguments, highlighting the need for personalized tool calling. To study this problem, we introduce MPT, a benchmark comprising 265 multi-session dialogues that cover three challenges: Preference Recall, Preference Induction, and Preference Transfer. We also propose PRefine, a test-time memory-augmented method that represents user preferences as evolving hypotheses. Through a generate--verify--refine loop, it extracts reusable constraints from history and improves tool-calling accuracy while using only 1.24% of the tokens required by full-history prompting. These results indicate that robust personalization in agentic systems depends on memory that captures the reasons behind user choices, not just the choices themselves.

AI.title_translation: 跨会话个性化工具调用的潜在偏好建模
AI.tldr: 该研究通过引入MPT基准和PRefine方法，解决了LLM代理中用户请求细节不足导致的工具调用挑战，显著提高了工具调用准确性并降低了token使用量。
AI.motivation: 用户在向基于LLM的代理发送请求时，经常省略基本细节，导致工具使用输入不完整。这给工具增强型代理带来了根本性挑战，因为API执行通常需要完整的参数，因此需要个性化的工具调用。
AI.method: 研究引入了MPT，一个包含265个多会话对话的基准，涵盖偏好召回、偏好归纳和偏好迁移三个挑战。同时提出了PRefine，一种测试时记忆增强方法，将用户偏好表示为不断演变的假设。它通过生成-验证-细化循环，从历史中提取可重用约束。
AI.result: PRefine方法提高了工具调用准确性，同时仅使用了完整历史提示所需token的1.24%。
AI.conclusion: 代理系统中强大的个性化依赖于能够捕捉用户选择背后原因的记忆，而不仅仅是选择本身。
AI.translation: 用户在向基于LLM的代理发送请求时，经常省略基本细节，导致工具使用输入不完整。这给工具增强型代理带来了根本性挑战，因为API执行通常需要完整的参数，因此需要个性化的工具调用。为了研究这个问题，我们引入了MPT，一个包含265个多会话对话的基准，涵盖偏好召回、偏好归纳和偏好迁移三个挑战。我们还提出了PRefine，一种测试时记忆增强方法，将用户偏好表示为不断演变的假设。通过生成-验证-细化循环，它从历史中提取可重用约束，并提高工具调用准确性，同时仅使用了完整历史提示所需token的1.24%。这些结果表明，代理系统中强大的个性化依赖于能够捕捉用户选择背后原因的记忆，而不仅仅是选择本身。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一个解决LLM代理中用户工具调用请求细节不足的问题。为此，研究引入了MPT基准，用于评估跨会话的偏好召回、归纳和迁移能力。此外，还提出了PRefine方法，通过记忆增强和生成-验证-细化循环，有效地从历史对话中提取用户偏好，显著提高了工具调用准确性，并大幅减少了所需token量。研究强调了记忆用户选择背后原因的重要性。
AI.keywords: LLM代理, 工具调用, 个性化, 潜在偏好, 记忆增强
AI.comments: 该论文通过提出MPT基准和PRefine方法，为解决LLM代理在处理不完整用户请求时的工具调用问题提供了创新的解决方案。PRefine在提高准确性同时大幅降低token使用量的能力，对于实际部署具有重要意义。强调捕捉用户选择背后原因的洞察力非常深刻，为未来个性化代理系统的发展指明了方向。

title: StableIDM: Stabilizing Inverse Dynamics Model against Manipulator Truncation via Spatio-Temporal Refinement
summary: Inverse Dynamics Models (IDMs) map visual observations to low-level action commands, serving as central components for data labeling and policy execution in embodied AI. However, their performance degrades severely under manipulator truncation, a common failure mode that makes state recovery ill-posed and leads to unstable control. We present StableIDM, a spatio-temporal framework that refines features from visual inputs to stabilize action predictions under such partial observability. StableIDM integrates three complementary components: (1) auxiliary robot-centric masking to suppress background clutter, (2) Directional Feature Aggregation (DFA) for geometry-aware spatial reasoning, which extracts anisotropic features along directions inferred from the visible arm and (3) Temporal Dynamics Refinement (TDR) to smooth and correct predictions via motion continuity. Extensive evaluations validate our approach: StableIDM improves strict action accuracy by 12.1% under severe truncation on the AgiBot benchmark, and increases average task success by 9.7% in real-robot replay. Moreover, it boosts end-to-end grasp success by 11.5% when decoding video-generated plans, and improves downstream VLA real-robot success by 17.6% when functioning as an automatic annotator. These results demonstrate that StableIDM provides a robust and scalable backbone for both policy execution and data generation in embodied artificial intelligence.

AI.title_translation: StableIDM：通过时空细化稳定逆动力学模型以应对机械臂截断
AI.tldr: StableIDM通过时空细化，提高了逆动力学模型在机械臂截断情况下的动作预测准确性和任务成功率，解决了现有模型在部分可观测性下的不稳定问题。
AI.motivation: 逆动力学模型（IDMs）在具身AI中是数据标注和策略执行的核心组件。然而，当机械臂被截断（一种常见的故障模式，导致状态恢复不适定并引起不稳定控制）时，它们的性能会严重下降。本研究旨在解决IDMs在机械臂截断下的性能退化问题。
AI.method: StableIDM是一个时空框架，通过细化视觉输入中的特征，在部分可观测性下稳定动作预测。它集成了三个互补组件：(1) 辅助机器人中心遮罩，用于抑制背景杂波；(2) 定向特征聚合（DFA），用于几何感知空间推理，从可见臂推断的方向提取各向异性特征；(3) 时间动态细化（TDR），通过运动连续性平滑和校正预测。
AI.result: StableIDM在AgiBot基准测试中，在严重截断下将严格动作准确性提高了12.1%；在真实机器人回放中，平均任务成功率提高了9.7%；在解码视频生成的计划时，端到端抓取成功率提高了11.5%；作为自动标注器时，下游VLA真实机器人成功率提高了17.6%。
AI.conclusion: StableIDM为具身人工智能中的策略执行和数据生成提供了一个鲁棒且可扩展的骨干。
AI.translation: 逆动力学模型（IDMs）将视觉观测映射到低级动作指令，是具身AI中数据标注和策略执行的核心组件。然而，当机械臂被截断时，它们的性能会严重下降，这是一种常见的故障模式，使得状态恢复成为一个病态问题并导致不稳定的控制。我们提出了StableIDM，这是一个时空框架，通过细化视觉输入中的特征，以在部分可观测性下稳定动作预测。StableIDM集成了三个互补组件：(1) 辅助机器人中心遮罩，用于抑制背景杂波；(2) 定向特征聚合（DFA），用于几何感知空间推理，它沿着从可见臂推断的方向提取各向异性特征；(3) 时间动态细化（TDR），通过运动连续性平滑和校正预测。广泛的评估验证了我们的方法：StableIDM在AgiBot基准测试中，在严重截断下将严格动作准确性提高了12.1%，并在真实机器人回放中将平均任务成功率提高了9.7%。此外，当解码视频生成的计划时，它将端到端抓取成功率提高了11.5%，并且当作为自动标注器时，将下游VLA真实机器人成功率提高了17.6%。这些结果表明，StableIDM为具身人工智能中的策略执行和数据生成提供了一个鲁棒且可扩展的骨干。
AI.summary: 本文提出了StableIDM，一个时空框架，旨在解决逆动力学模型（IDMs）在机械臂部分可见或截断情况下的性能下降问题。StableIDM通过结合辅助机器人中心遮罩、定向特征聚合（DFA）和时间动态细化（TDR）三个组件，从视觉输入中细化特征以稳定动作预测。实验结果表明，StableIDM在各种任务和基准测试中显著提高了动作准确性、任务成功率和抓取成功率，证明了其作为具身AI中策略执行和数据生成鲁棒骨干的潜力。
AI.keywords: 逆动力学模型, 机械臂截断, 时空细化, 具身AI, 动作预测
AI.comments: StableIDM的创新点在于其提出了一个综合性的时空框架来解决机械臂截断导致的逆动力学模型不稳定问题。通过结合空间推理（DFA）和时间连续性（TDR）以及背景抑制，该方法有效地处理了部分可观测性下的复杂挑战。其在多项具身AI任务中的显著性能提升，证明了该方法在提高机器人系统鲁棒性和可扩展性方面的重要性。

title: SpaceDex: Generalizable Dexterous Grasping in Tiered Workspaces
summary: Generalizable grasping with high-degree-of-freedom (DoF) dexterous hands remains challenging in tiered workspaces, where occlusion, narrow clearances, and height-dependent constraints are substantially stronger than in open tabletop scenes. Most existing methods are evaluated in relatively unoccluded settings and typically do not explicitly model the distinct control requirements of arm navigation and hand articulation under spatial constraints. We present SpaceDex, a hierarchical framework for dexterous manipulation in constrained 3D environments. At the high level, a Vision-Language Model (VLM) planner parses user intent, reasons about occlusion and height relations across multiple camera views, and generates target bounding boxes for zero-shot segmentation and mask tracking. This stage provides structured spatial guidance for downstream control instead of relying on single-view target selection. At the low level, we introduce an arm-hand Feature Separation Network that decouples global trajectory control for the arm from geometry-aware grasp mode selection for the hand, reducing feature interference between reaching and grasping objectives. The controller further integrates multi-view perception, fingertip tactile sensing, and a small set of recovery demonstrations to improve robustness to partial observability and off-nominal contacts. In 100 real-world trials involving over 30 unseen objects across four categories, SpaceDex achieves a 63.0\% success rate, compared with 39.0\% for a strong tabletop baseline. These results indicate that combining hierarchical spatial planning with arm-hand representation decoupling improves dexterous grasping performance in spatially constrained environments.

AI.title_translation: SpaceDex：分层工作空间中的通用灵巧抓取
AI.tldr: SpaceDex是一个分层框架，通过视觉语言模型规划和手臂-手部特征分离网络，提高了在受限3D环境中灵巧抓取的通用性，在真实世界试验中成功率达到63.0%。
AI.motivation: 在高自由度（DoF）灵巧手在分层工作空间中进行通用抓取仍然具有挑战性，因为这些空间中的遮挡、狭窄间隙和高度依赖性约束比开放桌面场景中要强得多。现有方法通常在相对无遮挡的环境中进行评估，并且没有明确建模空间约束下手臂导航和手部关节运动的不同控制要求。
AI.method: 本文提出了SpaceDex，一个用于受限3D环境中灵巧操作的分层框架。在高层，一个视觉语言模型（VLM）规划器解析用户意图，推理多相机视图下的遮挡和高度关系，并生成用于零样本分割和掩码跟踪的目标边界框，提供结构化的空间指导。在低层，引入了一个手臂-手部特征分离网络，它将手臂的全局轨迹控制与手部的几何感知抓取模式选择解耦，减少了到达和抓取目标之间的特征干扰。该控制器进一步整合了多视角感知、指尖触觉传感和少量恢复演示，以提高对部分可观察性和异常接触的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在100次真实世界试验中，涉及30多个未见过的物体和四个类别，SpaceDex实现了63.0%的成功率，而强大的桌面基线为39.0%。
AI.conclusion: 结合分层空间规划和手臂-手部表示解耦可以提高在空间受限环境中的灵巧抓取性能。

AI.summary: SpaceDex是一个用于在受限分层工作空间中实现通用灵巧抓取的分层框架。它通过高层的视觉语言模型进行空间规划，处理遮挡和高度关系，并生成结构化指导。在低层，它使用手臂-手部特征分离网络解耦手臂和手部的控制，并结合多视角感知和触觉传感提高鲁棒性。实验表明，SpaceDex在真实世界复杂场景中的抓取成功率显著高于基线方法。
AI.keywords: 灵巧抓取, 分层工作空间, 视觉语言模型, 特征分离网络, 机器人操作
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一个分层框架，并通过VLM进行高层空间规划和手臂-手部特征分离网络进行低层控制，有效解决了分层工作空间中灵巧抓取的挑战。其结合多模态感知和恢复策略也增强了系统的鲁棒性。

title: AeroRAG: Structured Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented LLM for Fine-Grained Aerial Visual Reasoning
summary: Despite recent progress in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), reliable visual question answering in aerial scenes remains challenging. In such scenes, task-critical evidence is often carried by small objects, explicit quantities, coarse locations, and inter-object relations, whereas conventional dense visual-token representations are not well aligned with these structured semantics. To address this interface mismatch, we propose AeroRAG, a scene-graph-guided multimodal retrieval-augmented generation framework for visual question answering. The framework first converts an input image into structured visual knowledge, including object categories, quantities, spatial locations, and semantic relations, and then retrieves query-relevant semantic chunks to construct compact prompts for a text-based large language model. Rather than relying on direct reasoning over dense visual tokens, our method introduces a more explicit intermediate interface between perception and language reasoning. Experiments on the AUG aerial dataset and the general-domain VG-150 benchmark show consistent improvements over six strong MLLM baselines, with the largest gains observed in dense aerial scenes and relation-sensitive reasoning. We further evaluate the framework on VQAv2 to verify that the proposed interface remains compatible with standard visual reasoning settings. These results suggest that structured retrieval is a practical design direction for deployment-oriented and grounded visual reasoning systems.

AI.title_translation: AeroRAG：用于细粒度航空视觉推理的结构化多模态检索增强型大型语言模型
AI.tldr: AeroRAG通过将航空图像转换为结构化视觉知识并检索相关语义块来构建紧凑提示，从而解决了多模态大型语言模型在航空场景视觉问答中面临的挑战，并在多个基准测试中取得了显著改进。
AI.motivation: 尽管多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）最近取得了进展，但在航空场景中进行可靠的视觉问答仍然具有挑战性。在这些场景中，关键任务证据通常由小物体、明确的数量、粗略的位置和物体间关系承载，而传统的密集视觉token表示与这些结构化语义不匹配。
AI.method: 我们提出了AeroRAG，一个场景图引导的多模态检索增强生成框架。该框架首先将输入图像转换为结构化视觉知识（包括物体类别、数量、空间位置和语义关系），然后检索与查询相关的语义块，为基于文本的大型语言模型构建紧凑提示。该方法引入了感知和语言推理之间更明确的中间接口，而不是直接依赖于对密集视觉token的推理。
AI.result: 在AUG航空数据集和通用领域VG-150基准测试上的实验表明，与六个强大的MLLM基线相比，AeroRAG取得了持续改进，其中在密集航空场景和关系敏感推理中观察到最大的增益。我们还在VQAv2上评估了该框架，以验证所提出的接口与标准视觉推理设置兼容。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果表明，结构化检索是面向部署和扎根视觉推理系统的一个实用设计方向。
AI.translation: 尽管多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）最近取得了进展，但在航空场景中进行可靠的视觉问答仍然具有挑战性。在这些场景中，关键任务证据通常由小物体、明确的数量、粗略的位置和物体间关系承载，而传统的密集视觉token表示与这些结构化语义并未很好地对齐。为了解决这种接口不匹配问题，我们提出了AeroRAG，一个场景图引导的多模态检索增强生成框架，用于视觉问答。该框架首先将输入图像转换为结构化视觉知识，包括物体类别、数量、空间位置和语义关系，然后检索与查询相关的语义块，为基于文本的大型语言模型构建紧凑提示。我们的方法引入了感知和语言推理之间更明确的中间接口，而不是直接依赖于对密集视觉token的推理。在AUG航空数据集和通用领域VG-150基准测试上的实验表明，与六个强大的MLLM基线相比，AeroRAG取得了持续改进，其中在密集航空场景和关系敏感推理中观察到最大的增益。我们还在VQAv2上评估了该框架，以验证所提出的接口与标准视觉推理设置兼容。这些结果表明，结构化检索是面向部署和扎根视觉推理系统的一个实用设计方向。
AI.summary: 本研究提出AeroRAG，一个场景图引导的多模态检索增强生成框架，旨在解决多模态大型语言模型在航空场景视觉问答中面临的挑战。针对传统密集视觉token表示与细粒度结构化语义不匹配的问题，AeroRAG将图像转换为结构化视觉知识，并通过检索相关语义块构建紧凑提示供文本LLM推理。实验结果表明，该方法在多个航空和通用领域数据集上均优于现有MLLM基线，尤其在密集航空场景和关系敏感推理方面表现突出，验证了结构化检索作为实用视觉推理系统设计方向的有效性。
AI.keywords: 航空视觉推理, 多模态大型语言模型, 检索增强生成, 场景图, 结构化知识
AI.comments: 本文的核心创新在于提出了一种结构化的中间接口来弥合感知与语言推理之间的鸿沟，特别是在航空视觉推理这种细粒度场景下。通过将图像转换为结构化知识图谱，并结合检索增强生成，AeroRAG有效地解决了传统密集视觉token表示的局限性。这种方法不仅提升了性能，也为未来可部署和扎根的视觉推理系统提供了新的设计思路，具有重要的实践意义。

title: Cache-Related Smells in GitLab CI/CD: Comprehensive Catalog, Automated Detection, and Empirical Evidence
comments: 12 pages, Evaluation and Assessment in Software Engineering (EASE) 2026
summary: Continuous Integration and Deployment (CI/CD) facilitate rapid software delivery, making fast feedback and minimal downtime essential. While caching has been shown to be an effective technique for tackling pipeline performance and reliability issues, existing works have primarily focused on missing dependency caches, ignoring other types of caches and cache misconfigurations. In this paper, we present a comprehensive catalog of ten cache-related smells in GitLab CI/CD that negatively impact performance and reliability, validated on a corpus of grey literature. To address the smells, we propose CROSSER, a tool that automatically detects seven of the ten smells. We evaluate CROSSER on a manually labeled dataset of 82 mature projects, achieving an overall F1 score of 0.98. Finally, we investigate the presence of smells across a large dataset of 228 mature open-source projects and outline our empirical findings. Our results show a widespread frequency of the smells, as only 11% of the projects do not present any. We also show that developers may not be aware of higher-level caching functionalities.
comment: 12 pages, Evaluation and Assessment in Software Engineering (EASE) 2026

AI.title_translation: GitLab CI/CD 中的缓存相关“异味”：综合目录、自动化检测和经验证据
AI.tldr: 本研究在GitLab CI/CD中识别并编目了十种影响性能和可靠性的缓存相关“异味”。它提出了一个名为CROSSER的自动化检测工具，能够检测其中七种异味，并在评估中取得了0.98的F1分数。实证研究表明，这些异味在开源项目中普遍存在，只有11%的项目没有发现任何异味，并且开发者可能对更高级别的缓存功能不了解。
AI.motivation: 现有关于CI/CD流水线性能和可靠性中缓存的研究主要集中在缺失的依赖缓存上，忽略了其他类型的缓存和缓存配置错误。本研究旨在填补这一空白，识别并解决GitLab CI/CD中更广泛的缓存相关问题。
AI.method: 本研究首先建立了一个包含十种GitLab CI/CD中缓存相关“异味”的综合目录，并通过灰色文献语料库进行验证。接着，提出了一个名为CROSSER的工具，能够自动检测其中七种异味。该工具在一个包含82个手动标注的成熟项目的数据集上进行了评估。最后，研究人员在一个包含228个成熟开源项目的大型数据集上调查了这些异味的普遍性，并概述了经验发现。
AI.result: CROSSER工具在检测七种缓存相关“异味”方面取得了0.98的F1分数。实证结果显示，这些“异味”普遍存在，只有11%的项目没有出现任何“异味”。研究还表明，开发者可能不了解更高级别的缓存功能。
AI.conclusion: GitLab CI/CD中的缓存相关“异味”普遍存在，显著影响了性能和可靠性，并且开发者对此类问题可能缺乏认知。自动化工具如CROSSER能够有效检测这些问题，从而有助于改进CI/CD流水线。
AI.translation: 持续集成和部署（CI/CD）促进了快速软件交付，使得快速反馈和最小停机时间至关重要。虽然缓存已被证明是解决流水线性能和可靠性问题的有效技术，但现有工作主要集中在缺失的依赖缓存上，忽略了其他类型的缓存和缓存配置错误。在本文中，我们提出了一个包含GitLab CI/CD中十种缓存相关“异味”的综合目录，这些“异味”对性能和可靠性产生负面影响，并在灰色文献语料库上进行了验证。为了解决这些“异味”，我们提出了CROSSER，一个能够自动检测其中七种“异味”的工具。我们在一个包含82个手动标注的成熟项目的数据集上评估了CROSSER，取得了0.98的总体F1分数。最后，我们调查了228个成熟开源项目的大型数据集中“异味”的存在情况，并概述了我们的经验发现。我们的结果显示，“异味”的频率普遍存在，因为只有11%的项目没有出现任何“异味”。我们还表明，开发者可能不了解更高级别的缓存功能。
AI.summary: 本论文识别并编目了GitLab CI/CD中十种影响性能和可靠性的缓存相关“异味”。为了解决这些问题，研究提出了一个名为CROSSER的自动化工具，能够检测其中七种“异味”，并在评估中取得了0.98的F1分数。通过对228个开源项目进行的大规模实证研究发现，这些“异味”普遍存在，仅有11%的项目未受影响，同时揭示了开发者对更高级别缓存功能认知不足的现象。
AI.keywords: 缓存相关异味, GitLab CI/CD, 自动化检测, 经验证据, 流水线性能
AI.comments: 本文通过系统地编目GitLab CI/CD中缓存相关的“异味”，并开发自动化检测工具CROSSER，为CI/CD流水线优化提供了一个实用的解决方案。其创新之处在于超越了传统对缺失依赖缓存的关注，涵盖了更广泛的缓存配置问题。实证证据表明这些“异味”普遍存在，凸显了该研究的实际重要性。此外，指出现有开发者对高级缓存功能认知不足的局限性，为未来的工具设计和开发者教育提供了明确方向。

title: LEPO: \underline{L}atent R\underline{e}asoning \underline{P}olicy \underline{O}ptimization for Large Language~Models
summary: Recently, latent reasoning has been introduced into large language models (LLMs) to leverage rich information within a continuous space. However, without stochastic sampling, these methods inevitably collapse to deterministic inference, failing to discover diverse reasoning paths. To bridge the gap, we inject controllable stochasticity into latent reasoning via Gumbel-Softmax, restoring LLMs' exploratory capacity and enhancing their compatibility with Reinforcement Learning (RL). Building on this, we propose \textbf{\underline{L}}atent R\textbf{\underline{e}}asoning \textbf{\underline{P}}olicy \textbf{\underline{O}}ptimization~(\textbf{LEPO}), a novel framework that applies RL directly to continuous latent representations. Specifically, in rollout stage, LEPO maintains stochasticity to enable diverse trajectory sampling, while in optimization stage, LEPO constructs a unified gradient estimation for both latent representations and discrete tokens. Extensive experiments show that LEPO significantly outperforms existing RL methods for discrete and latent reasoning.

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型的潜在推理策略优化
AI.tldr: 通过引入Gumbel-Softmax来控制随机性，LEPO框架将强化学习应用于连续潜在表示，实现了比现有方法更优的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的潜在推理方法倾向于确定性推理，忽略了探索多样化推理路径的能力。
AI.method: LEPO框架将强化学习直接应用于连续潜在表示，在滚动阶段保持随机性以实现多样化轨迹采样，在优化阶段为潜在表示和离散标记构建统一的梯度估计。
AI.result: LEPO在离散和潜在推理方面显著优于现有的强化学习方法。
AI.conclusion: LEPO通过引入可控随机性，成功地将强化学习应用于LLM的潜在推理，提高了其探索能力和整体性能。
AI.translation: 最近，潜在推理被引入大型语言模型（LLMs）中，以利用连续空间中的丰富信息。然而，在没有随机采样的情况下，这些方法不可避免地会陷入确定性推理，无法发现多样化的推理路径。为了弥合这一差距，我们通过Gumbel-Softmax将可控随机性注入潜在推理，恢复了LLMs的探索能力，并增强了它们与强化学习（RL）的兼容性。在此基础上，我们提出了潜在推理策略优化（LEPO），这是一个将RL直接应用于连续潜在表示的新颖框架。具体来说，在滚动阶段，LEPO保持随机性以实现多样化的轨迹采样，而在优化阶段，LEPO为潜在表示和离散标记构建统一的梯度估计。大量实验表明，LEPO在离散和潜在推理方面显著优于现有的RL方法。
AI.summary: LEPO是一种新颖的框架，通过Gumbel-Softmax将可控随机性引入LLM的潜在推理，解决了现有方法倾向于确定性推理的问题。该框架将强化学习直接应用于连续潜在表示，在滚动阶段利用随机性进行多样化采样，在优化阶段进行统一梯度估计，实验证明其在离散和潜在推理任务上均优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 潜在推理, 强化学习, 大型语言模型, Gumbel-Softmax, 策略优化
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入可控随机性解决了潜在推理的确定性问题，并成功将强化学习应用于连续潜在表示，这是一个有前景的方向。然而，在实际应用中，如何平衡随机性和效率，以及该方法在更广泛任务上的泛化能力仍需进一步研究。

title: Empowering Vocabulary Learning Through Teaching AI: Using LLMs as a Student to Perform Learning by Teaching in Vocabulary Acquisition
summary: "Learning by Teaching (LbT)" helps learners deepen their understanding by explaining concepts to others, with questions playing a vital role in identifying knowledge gaps and reinforcing comprehension. However, existing systems for generating such questions often rely on rigid templates and are expensive to build. To overcome these limitations, we developed a system using Large Language Models (LLMs) to create dynamic, contextually relevant questions for LbT. In our English vocabulary learning study, we examined which learner characteristics best leverage the system's benefits. Our results showed improved memory retention over traditional methods at three and seven days of testing, with ten participants. Additionally, we identified traits linked to better learning outcomes, highlighting the potential for tailored approaches. These findings support the development of scalable, cost-effective solutions to enhance LbT methods across various fields.

AI.title_translation: 赋能词汇学习通过教学AI：使用大型语言模型作为学生进行教学式学习以获取词汇
AI.tldr: 本研究使用大型语言模型（LLMs）开发了一个新的“教学式学习”（LbT）系统，用于生成动态的、情境相关的词汇学习问题，克服了传统模板化和昂贵系统的限制。研究表明，该LLM驱动的LbT方法在词汇记忆保持方面优于传统方法，并确定了影响学习效果的个人特征，为开发可扩展、经济高效的教育解决方案提供了支持。
AI.motivation: 现有用于生成“教学式学习”（LbT）问题的系统依赖于僵化的模板且构建成本高昂。本研究旨在开发一种利用大型语言模型（LLMs）创建动态、情境相关问题的系统，以克服这些限制并提升词汇学习效果。
AI.method: 开发了一个使用大型语言模型（LLMs）的系统，用于为“教学式学习”（LbT）生成动态的、情境相关的词汇学习问题。在一项英语词汇学习研究中，评估了该系统，并分析了哪些学习者特征最能利用该系统的优势。
AI.result: 在为期三到七天的测试中，与传统方法相比，记忆保持能力有所提高。研究还确定了与更好学习成果相关的学习者特征，表明了个性化教学方法的潜力。该研究有十名参与者。
AI.conclusion: 本研究开发的LLM驱动的LbT系统在词汇记忆保持方面优于传统方法，并能识别出有助于提高学习效果的学习者特征。这为创建可扩展、经济高效的教育解决方案奠定了基础，可应用于不同领域。
AI.translation: “教学式学习”（LbT）通过让学习者向他人解释概念来帮助他们加深理解，其中问题在识别知识差距和巩固理解方面起着至关重要的作用。然而，现有的用于生成此类问题的系统往往依赖于僵化的模板且构建成本高昂。为了克服这些限制，我们开发了一个使用大型语言模型（LLMs）的系统，为LbT创建动态的、情境相关的问。在我们的一项英语词汇学习研究中，我们研究了哪些学习者特征最能利用该系统的优势。我们的结果表明，在为期三到七天的测试中，与传统方法相比，记忆保持能力有所提高，共有十名参与者。此外，我们还确定了与更好学习成果相关的特征，突显了个性化方法的潜力。这些发现支持了开发可扩展、经济高效的解决方案以在各个领域改进LbT方法的开发。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种利用大型语言模型（LLMs）的新型“教学式学习”（LbT）系统，用于生成动态且情境相关的词汇学习问题，克服了传统方法的局限性。实验结果显示，与传统方法相比，该系统能显著提高记忆保持率，并识别出影响学习效果的学习者特征，为开发更有效的个性化教育工具提供了依据。
AI.keywords: 教学式学习, 大型语言模型, 词汇习得, 问题生成, 记忆保持
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地利用了大型语言模型的生成能力来革新“教学式学习”方法，解决了传统LbT系统在灵活性和成本方面的痛点。研究结果令人鼓舞，表明该方法在提高词汇记忆方面具有潜力。然而，样本量（十名参与者）相对较小，未来需要更大规模的研究来验证其普遍适用性。此外，对“学习者特征”的具体分析有待深入，以更好地指导个性化教学策略的设计。

title: Automatic Slide Updating with User-Defined Dynamic Templates and Natural Language Instructions
comments: To appear in Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026)
summary: Presentation slides are a primary medium for data-driven reporting, yet keeping complex, analytics-style decks up to date remains labor-intensive. Existing automation methods mostly follow fixed template filling and cannot support dynamic updates for diverse, user-authored slide decks. We therefore define "Dynamic Slide Update via Natural Language Instructions on User-provided Templates" and introduce DynaSlide, a large-scale benchmark with 20,036 real-world instruction-execution triples (source slide, user instruction, target slide) grounded in a shared external database and built from business reporting slides under bring-your-own-template (BYO-template) conditions. To tackle this task, we propose SlideAgent, an agent-based framework that combines multimodal slide parsing, natural language instruction grounding, and tool-augmented reasoning for tables, charts, and textual conclusions. SlideAgent updates content while preserving layout and style, providing a strong reference baseline on DynaSlide. We further design end-to-end and component-level evaluation protocols that reveal key challenges and opportunities for future research. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/XiaoZhou2024/SlideAgent.
